bibliographic_scope.title: Synthesis and Self-Assembly of Photonic Materials from Nanocrystalline Titania Sheets
bibliographic_scope.authors: Jian Zhu; Jinguo Wang; Fujian Lv; Shengxiong Xiao; Colin Nuckolls; Hexing Li
bibliographic_scope.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

interpretations.topic: Powder and film use different charges
interpretations.text: The powder recipe uses 0.10 g TiF4 and 160 °C for 24 h. The coloured film uses 0.010 g TiF4, adds 5 mL tert-butyl alcohol and reacts at 130 °C for 24 h with titanium foil present. Vessel capacity is 50 mL in both protocols, not a reported liquid volume.

interpretations.topic: Early precursor, sheets and stacks are different objects
interpretations.text: The 3 h material is an amorphous organic-rich titanium precursor. Later crystallinity, lamellar spacing, plate thickness and overall assembly dimensions describe different structural levels. The source supplies fixed temperature and stoichiometry for the time series, but does not separately restate each absolute charge.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, Figure 2 time series

interpretations.text: Ratios TiF4:benzyl alcohol = 1:4800, 1:1200, 1:600 and 1:240 are separate comparisons at 160 °C for 24 h. A useful range 1:2400 to 1:300 is stated in the discussion, not a list of individually measured specimens. High fluoride loading is proposed to generate excess HF that etches (001) facets; neither HF concentration nor this mechanism is directly measured.

interpretations.topic: Surface-mediated assembly is an author model
interpretations.text: Figure 3 proposes benzyl groups and π stacking between sheets. The text gives adjacent surface Ti separation about 0.4 nm and model interlayer spacing 0.92 nm; the diagram also labels 0.38 and 0.76 nm along the surface. These are model dimensions, distinct from the approximately 1.3 nm HRTEM spacing in the 5 h specimen. No source coordinates or unit-cell model are supplied.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, Figure 3 and model discussion

interpretations.text: Pentafluorobenzyl alcohol alone gives no sheets or stacking. Its 1:1 v/v mixture with benzyl alcohol restores organized stacks with a reported gap of 5 ± 2 nm. Among the para-halogen examples, fluoro gives stacked sheets while chloro and bromo give sheets without stacking. Substituent size and aromatic interactions are the authors’ explanations, not measured molecular structures. Aliphatic-alcohol negative observations retain their missing separate conditions.

Figure S3 reports losses of 78, 64, 43, 38, 33 and 24% at reaction times 3, 5, 8, 12, 18 and 24 h, respectively. Its printed axis convention is retained. The authors assign 1489 cm−1 to aromatic rings and broad features at 3010 and 2893 cm−1 to interactions at the TiO2 surface. The latter features are absent for physisorbed benzyl alcohol on commercial P25. Figure S4 includes 12 h and 24 h products, pure P25, adsorbed P25 and pure benzyl alcohol. Adsorption preparation is unreported.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, TGA and FTIR discussion

interpretations.text: The green layered film on Ti foil is 190 ± 10 nm thick and has diffuse-reflectance bands near 400 and 640 nm. Conditions for every observed colour are not supplied. The sol-gel procedure explicitly coats glass, whereas its heading, main comparison and Figure S8 refer to Ti foil. The relationship is unresolved; comparison thickness is not silently assigned to the glass specimen.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3, Figure 4 and sol-gel comparison
SI PDF p. 1, 6, Sol-gel preparation and Figure S8

interpretations.text: Introductory photovoltaic, photocatalytic and reflective-coating applications are motivation or prospective uses, not performance measurements of these samples. Reference note 15 says titanium alkoxides behave similarly when HF is added, but gives no complete additional recipe. Cited full sources are unreviewed.

source_conflicts: Main p. 2 describes a broad (001) XRD reflection whereas Figure S1 labels the broad peak (004); indexing discrepancy retained.
Sol-gel heading, main comparison and Figure S8 specify Ti foil, but the SI operational paragraph twice specifies glass. The relationship between these specimens remains unresolved.
Figure S3 calls its ordinate Weight Loss (%) while the traces begin near 100 and decrease. The caption-reported loss percentages are retained without reinterpreting or digitizing the curves.
Main Figure 1 caption calls panel c small angle electron diffraction; body calls it selected-area electron diffraction.
Main describes low visible-light absorption for the sol-gel comparison, while Figure S8 reports diffuse reflectance; neither signal is converted.
limitations: Complete supplied main (3 pages) and matched SI (6 pages) author-read; cited full papers unreviewed.
Independent source audit passed; presentation remains pending.
Reagent purity/supplier, heating ramp, autoclave pressure, agitation during reaction, cooling rate, centrifugation settings, wash volumes/repetitions and powder drying are unreported.
Time, feed-ratio and alcohol comparisons preserve their own stated conditions; separate absolute charges and individual batch identities are not automatically inherited.
No atomic coordinates or refined unit-cell constants supplied. Molecular presentation is pending for new identity-only cards; stage drawings are illustrative.
